subject: [PATCH v4 2/4] btrfs: pre-allocate delayed dir index before btree modification

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Btrfs file system to pre-allocate delayed directory index space before modifying the btree. This change prevents ENOMEM failures from leaving the btree in a partially-modified state, which could only be resolved by aborting the transaction. The patch also introduces an optional parameter for callers to provide their own pre-allocated space, and removes a wrapper function that was no longer needed.
